items.exampleEn: I have a good feeling about this.
items.exampleZh: 我對這件事有好的預感。

items.exampleEn: I have happy memories of my school days.
items.exampleZh: 我有求學時期的快樂回憶。

items.sentenceEn: I hope you feel better soon.

items.audioEn: I feel happy when I think of my old friends.
items.audioZh: 想到老朋友時，我就覺得很開心。
items.questionZh: 說話者什麼時候覺得開心？
options: When I think of old friends

items.sentenceEn: I like his character very much.

items.stemEn: I ____ sick today. I want to stay in bed.
items.stemZh: 我今天覺得不舒服，想待在床上。

items.stemEn: Where there is life, there is ____.

items.passageEn: My grandmother is eighty, but she has a strong character. She has many memories of her school days. Those were hard years, but she always had hope. Today, she feels happy when she plays with us. I believe she is the strongest woman in my family.
items.passageZh: 我奶奶八十歲了，但她的個性很堅強。她有很多求學時期的回憶。那些年很辛苦，但她一直懷抱希望。現在，她跟我們一起玩的時候就覺得很快樂。我相信她是我們家最堅強的女人。

questions.questionZh: 奶奶有很多關於什麼的回憶？
奶奶現在什麼時候覺得快樂？

rubricZh: 「覺得」可用 feel＋形容詞（例如 feel happy），寫 I am happy 也正確
feel 後面接形容詞，不用副詞（不寫 feel happily）

items.instructionZh: 用 memory 造一個句子，說說你的一個美好回憶。
referenceEn: I have a happy memory of my first trip to Japan.
My best memory is my tenth birthday party.
rubricZh: 可用 I have a … memory of…，或 My best memory is… 等
說回憶裡的事可用過去式
